articles.title: GTA 6 Leaks Keep Coming: Hyper-Realistic Driving Footage Has Fans Hyped and 2K Furious
articles.summary: A persistent leaker known as Cyberleek has released another GTA 6 clip, this time showing incredibly detailed driving and stunning puddle reflections. The footage has fans excited but publisher 2K is on a legal warpath, subpoenaing Microsoft and Discord. The official reveal is set for Netflix on August 27.

articles.title: Injury Woes: Sinner and Draper Withdraw from US Open, Alcaraz Returns
articles.summary: World No. 1 Jannik Sinner and Britain's Jack Draper have both withdrawn from the US Open due to injuries. Sinner cited a knee issue, while Draper continues to struggle with a long-term arm injury. Meanwhile, Carlos Alcaraz is set to return after a four-month absence with a wrist injury.

articles.title: We Tested the Best Robotic Pool Cleaners of 2026: Beatbot, iGarden, and Dreame
articles.summary: After four years of testing, the Beatbot AquaSense 2 Ultra is the top robotic pool cleaner, but at $3,000 and 29 pounds, it's not for everyone. The Dreame Z1 Pro, now just $499, offers great value, while the iGarden M1-AI can run for up to nine hours on a single charge.
